name: Chao trang
summary: Cháo trắng is plain rice porridge with a fish braise beside it: cá kho on one account, kho cá cơm on the other.
origin: A Huỳnh Thúc Kháng breakfast. One account pairs it with cá kho, the other with kho cá cơm. Both stay.
howToEat: Order the porridge with the fish the counter is braising that morning. One account says cá kho. The other says kho cá cơm.
where: Huỳnh Thúc Kháng, in the morning. One account says the street is crowded from 06:00 to 08:00. The 2019 account prints 06:00–12:00.
seoTitle: Chao trang — porridge and fish on the breakfast street
seoDescription: Cháo trắng is plain rice porridge on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng, with cá kho on one account and kho cá cơm on the other.
